lines.text: A fugitive from Jerusalem tells Ezekiel the city has been taken, and the LORD opens Ezekiel's mouth the evening before.
The people in the ruins say that Abraham was only one man, yet they are many, so the land is theirs.
God says those in the ruins will fall by the sword, those in the open field will be devoured by wild animals, and those in caves will die by famine.
Ezekiel's people talk about him near the city gates, and they hear his words but do not put them into practice.
To the people, Ezekiel is like a singer of love songs, and when it comes to pass they will know a prophet has been among them.
